One run per program, local machine (GnuCOBOL 3.2, JDK 21). Copied to the public run list on Nov 3, 2026, local paths removed, the two uncertified runs included.

counterexamples.why: Amount field has embedded space at 2nd integer digit. COBOL keeps positional weight (space=0 => 1000000.00) so CL-DEBIT is -1000000.00, Java strips space and concatenates digits to 100000.00 so CL-DEBIT and NET and CL-REC differ

Fee field 9(3)V99 has embedded space at 10s position. COBOL treats space as 0 at weight 10 => 100.00 doubled to 200.00, Java concatenates to 10.00 doubled to 20.00 => CL-FEE file field and WS-TOTAL differ
